Based on the chest X-ray provided, there is evidence of **left base pulmonary atelectasis**.

The left hemidiaphragm appears slightly elevated, and there is a subtle increase in opacity in the lower lung fields on the left side. This suggests a possible collapse or consolidation in the left lower lobe.

While I cannot definitively rule out right base atelectasis without a more detailed evaluation, the findings are more prominent on the left side.

It is important to note that this is a preliminary interpretation based on a single image. A full assessment would require reviewing the entire X-ray, including the lateral view, and potentially additional imaging studies.
